open_points.subject: A03 sandbox loopback configuration
open_points.text: no network interface but the namespace's own loopback — up
open_points.question: What exact interface, address and route state qualifies as the required up loopback environment?
options: Only an administratively up loopback interface is required; addresses and routes are unspecified
Require lo up with specified IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses and no non-loopback routes
Require IPv4 loopback, with IPv6 presence determined by the host
open_points.default_guess: Require exactly the namespace-local loopback interface, administratively up with 127.0.0.1/8 and, when IPv6 is enabled, ::1/128, and no non-loopback routes.

open_points.subject: A03 network-isolation boundary
open_points.question: Which protocols and destinations must be unreachable for this condition to hold, and is communication between processes of the same execution over loopback permitted at the isolation boundary?
options: Only IP connectivity through non-loopback interfaces is prohibited
All socket-addressable endpoints outside the execution are prohibited, while processes within the same execution may communicate over its loopback
All networking, including communication between processes within the execution over loopback, is prohibited despite the interface being up
open_points.default_guess: Treat every endpoint outside the execution—including the host, other executions, services and the Internet—as unreachable across all supported network families; allow namespace-local loopback at the isolation boundary, while Python socket attempts still become sandbox_violation under rule 4.

open_points.subject: A03 sandbox startup and execution checks
open_points.question: Must the startup probe or every execution verify that loopback is up and that no outside destination is reachable, and what happens when the required topology cannot be confirmed?
options: The startup probe verifies the topology and the kernel refuses to start if it does not conform
Every execution verifies the topology and a failed verification becomes an execution outcome
The kernel assumes bubblewrap provides the stated topology and performs no verification
open_points.default_guess: Have the startup probe verify the required topology and refuse kernel startup when it cannot be confirmed; treat a later failure to construct that topology as a crashed execution before user code runs.
